# Moons (@moonsjs)

> Moons is a full-stack TypeScript web framework (file routing, SSR, React
> hydration) whose one guarantee is that server code can never leak into the
> client bundle. `*.server.ts` files are replaced by RPC stubs in the client
> build; smuggling their content into client code fails the build.

## Online docs

- Site: https://docs.devmoon.net
- Raw markdown for agents: https://docs.devmoon.net/raw/ai/CONTEXT.md
- Bundles: https://docs.devmoon.net/llms.txt · https://docs.devmoon.net/llms-full.txt
- Bahasa Indonesia: https://docs.devmoon.net/id/

## For AI agents

- [AI context pack](ai/CONTEXT.md): compact guide — routing, loaders, serverFn, ctx/env, navigation, security rules, verified patterns.
- [CLI JSON contract](ai/cli-json.md): stable `moons routes|fns|check --json` schemas for machine consumption.
- [Recipes](ai/recipes/search-params.md): query params, mutations + `refresh()`, two-sided validation, dynamic routes, custom 404/error, secrets/env, testing.

## Examples

- [Cookbook](https://github.com/moonsjs/cookbook): canonical patterns, compiled and CI-tested.

## Reference

- [API reference](api/README.md): per-package docs (core, server, react, vite, cli, mcp).
- [Architecture](manifest.md): why the server/client boundary is dangerous and how Moons enforces it.

## Repositories

Packages are developed in the open under [`moonsjs`](https://github.com/moonsjs):
`core` · `server` · `react` · `vite` · `cli` · `mcp`, plus `docs` and `cookbook`.
Issues and pull requests are welcome in each repository.
